name: 資料を共有した相手と付与権限の履歴
prompt: Render one Japanese Lighthouse sharing-history entry, LH15-0027. Input1 ORIGINAL Dropbox screenshot is PRIMARY for avatar silhouette, relative dimensions, alignment and spacing: use only its 'Sam Lee / Shared with 1 person / Alex Smith / Can view' activity entry. Actor badge is rounded-square squircle, recipient badge is smaller rounded-square; respect original anatomy rather than our mock's mint circles. Input2 FigCraft MOCK is SECONDARY for exact translated content and standalone scope. Input3 approved category-card is material guidance only. One compact white rounded card, roughly3:1 aspect, on pure white landscape canvas with modest margins. Top group:28x28px white outlined rounded-SQUARE avatar, clearly short flat sides with about9px corner radius, slate initial「鈴」. To right, exact「鈴木 まこと」in Meiryo Regular14/24, below「1人と共有 · 12:23」in muted Regular12/16. Retain mock's translated time12:23. Under that text column with8px indent and modest top gap, a row of a smaller22x22px white outlined rounded-SQUARE avatar「佐」, exact recipient「佐藤 はるか」Regular12/16, and right-aligned permission「閲覧可能」muted Regular12/16 at far right. Keep actor distinct from recipient, permissions visibly associated with the recipient. Use original grouping and recipient-to-actor size ratio, no circle replacement. Neutral outline/slate initials replace original purple/pink identity colors and mint mock, because no functional status is encoded by those colors. Pure white card and canvas, very fine neutral border and soft shallow shadow, ink#1D1D1D, muted#6E6E6E, slate#526173. Tracking0 and normal regular weight throughout. This entry has no primary action or selected state; no forced green or new colored controls. Exact2people,1recipient,1permission, all Japanese wording preserved. No titles, timeline dividers, chevrons, extra buttons, avatars, phonechrome, English copy or watermark. Crisp high-resolution raster candidate.

Original relative actor/recipient badge sizes and roundedsquare silhouettes restored over mockmintcircles; whiteoutline/slate adaptation. Permission rightaligned inrecipientrow.
